summary: legal checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the product private. Evidence: official API access is documented, but rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established; current public terms point against those uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, owner, and privacy gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible fleet growth is conditional where existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved; incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Revenue evidence is partial: $4.92 aggregate commission cannot be assigned to a site and site-attributed commission is $0. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Evidence progress is partial only: official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy/cookie pages, and draft terms are recorded. Do not close any task. Next evidence action: attach one read-only bundle covering alert identifiers and data flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 consent/settings/retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures; maintain a separate field-level rights matrix and unsent permission packet for owner and human-counsel review. Do not send outreach or change the private gate.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; missing written permission/API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate/advertising permission. Smallest action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent packet to human counsel and the owner. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest action: produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest action: produce the read-only operator/vendor and incident inventory.
